title: iorb / interest on reserve balances / fed policy floor | Market Notice | Interest on Reserve Balances (IORB)
summary: The Interest on Reserve Balances (IORB) rate remained flat at 3.65% as of April 14, 2026, unchanged from the prior observation on April 13. The rate has been constant at 3.65% from April 10 through April 14, 2026, indicating no change in the Fed's reserve remuneration policy during this period.
